blocks.text: TACLOBAN CITY — Students of Leyte Normal University (LNU) in this city are now allowed to wear appropriate civilian attire on campus following the temporary suspension of the university’s prescribed uniform due to rising temperatures. The LNU Supreme Student Council (SSC) said that the adjustment took effect on Tuesday in response to the high heat index forecast by the Philippine Atmospheric, Geophysical and Astronomical Services Administration (Pagasa). Despite the suspension, the more than 7,000 students are still required to observe the grooming standards stipulated in the 2022 edition of the university’s student handbook and wear their identification cards at all times […]...
